The '''Temporary Archive for Integration of Materials Related to the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]''' was an archive located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[139 ABY]], [[Yalta Val]] used it to look up information on [[Ania Solo]] and the murder of [[Teemen Alton]].
